transcript:
JULIANA: You don't know what my family has done to me.

MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN: I know they have made you stand alone.

MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN: You don't have to stand alone now.
CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana, her pride flaring through her sadness.
JULIANA: If this is pity, take back your ring.
CAMERA: Tight close-up on Juliana's face, a tear clinging to her cheek.
JULIANA: I will not become anyone's charity.
CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man holding her gaze directly.
MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN: It is not pity, Lady Juliana.
CAMERA: Intense tight close-up on his piercing blue-green eyes and facial scars.
MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN: It is a vow.
CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana, completely disarmed by the gravity of his promise.
JULIANA: I don't know this man.
CAMERA: Medium shot of Lady Ashcroft, Clarissa, and Lord Ashcroft seated coldly in the family pew.
JULIANA: I don't know what waits beyond these doors.
CAMERA: Side profile close-up of Juliana looking toward her estranged family, then turning back.
JULIANA: But he looked at me when everyone else turned away.
CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana facing down at him, a faint, tender smile breaking across her lips.
JULIANA: Then I accept.
CAMERA: Wide shot of the altar with the high cathedral stained glass overhead as the Priest looks on between them.
CAMERA: Medium shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man rising smoothly to his feet before Juliana.
ACTION: The Mysterious Bearded Man stands tall, extending his scarred hand toward Juliana.
CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's slender hand resting gently into his large, weathered palm.
ACTION: He folds his fingers over hers, holding her hand with protective firmness.
CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Priest holding his open liturgical book, bewildered and trembling.
THE PRIEST: My- My Lady...
CAMERA: Tight close-up of the Priest's alarmed, questioning eyes.
THE PRIEST: Are you certain?
CAMERA: Medium shot of Lord Ashcroft seated in his pew, gripping his cane, bowed in grim silence.
CAMERA: Close-up profile of Juliana, her expression clear and unshakable.
JULIANA: I am.

CAMERA: Low-angle close-up of Gerald tilting his chin up, daringly baiting Alexander.
GERALD: What is it, soldier? Going to strike a gentleman in front of his wife?

ALEXANDER: One blow would end this.

ALEXANDER: But one blow would destroy her life.

CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Juliana gasping in sheer horror, her eyes welling with shock and shattered disbelief.

CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Alexander's face hardening into lethal, icy comprehension, realizing the depth of the frame-up.

transcript:
CAMERA: Wide two-shot across the puddle-strewn ground between Gerald and Juliana against the misty landscape.
GERALD: I came for something that belongs to me.
CAMERA: Close-up of Clarissa peering from the carriage window in her violet silk gown, a venomous, triumphant smile curling her lips.
CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana, her anger flaring as she gestures sharply.
JULIANA: You have already taken enough from me. Leave!
CAMERA: Medium close-up of Gerald pointing an accusatory finger, his composure snapping into hostile anger.
GERALD: Your husband stole my gold pocket watch!
CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana recoiling in utter disbelief.
JULIANA: What? When?
CAMERA: Close-up of Gerald narrowing his eyes vindictively.
GERALD: The last time I came here.
CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana scoffing, stepping forward as Alexander stands motionless behind her.
JULIANA: You never even entered the cottage!
CAMERA: Close-up of Gerald smirking with condescending amusement.
GERALD: Then you should have nothing to fear from a search.
CAMERA: Three-shot of Alexander, Juliana, and Gerald in the bleak drizzle.
JULIANA: Alexander would never steal from you.
CAMERA: Low-angle shot of Gerald throwing his head back in arrogant, mocking laughter.
GERALD: Of course you would defend him. You married a beggar!
CAMERA: Medium close-up of Alexander stepping past Juliana, his gaze murderous and jaw rigid.
ALEXANDER: Choose your next words carefully.
CAMERA: Medium shot of Gerald pointing back toward the approaching Constable, feigning alarm.
GERALD: You hear that? He threatens me again!
CAMERA: Medium shot of the Constable marching into frame between them, holding his truncheon horizontally.
CONSTABLE: I have received a complaint of theft.
CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Juliana, defiant and resolute.
JULIANA: A complaint is not proof.
CAMERA: Close-up of the Constable gesturing with his truncheon toward the cottage door.
CONSTABLE: Then a search will settle the matter.
CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana backing up to the doorway, spreading her arms wide to block the entrance.
JULIANA: You cannot simply invade our home because this man makes an accusation!
CAMERA: Medium close-up of Gerald crossing his arms smugly.
GERALD: If he has nothing to hide...
CAMERA: Extreme close-up push-in on Alexander's scarred face, his eyes smoldering with lethal restraint.
GERALD: ...let the constable search.
ALEXANDER: Search it.
CAMERA: Medium two-shot of Juliana looking up at Alexander in panicked confusion.
ALEXANDER: Let them.
CAMERA: Medium shot looking out the doorway as Juliana steps aside and the Constable barges past into the dimly lit cottage.
SOUND: Heavy thud of boots entering wooden floorboards, followed by forceful banging of furniture.
ACTION: The Constable begins violently overturning crates and dumping contents across the floor.
CAMERA: Medium low-angle shot of Juliana dropping to her knees, frantically trying to salvage bundles of dried herbs scattering across the boards.
JULIANA: Stop! Those are my mother's medicines!
hook: I came for something that belongs to me.
cliffhanger: Stop! Those are my mother's medicines!

CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander struggling in agony, tears forming in his eyes.
ALEXANDER: Please... enough!
CAMERA: Wide tunnel shot through the briars as Juliana crawls deeper into the dark, frozen tangle.
ACTION: Juliana drags her body across the frozen, cracked soil beneath the dense roof of briars.
CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's hand getting snagged between two vicious thorns, tearing her sleeve and flesh.
JULIANA: Ah!
ACTION: Alexander loses control, violently lunging past the Constable toward the briars.
CAMERA: Medium tracking shot of Alexander breaking into a desperate charge.
ALEXANDER: Stop!
ACTION: Juliana continues clawing forward, branches lacerating her arm and cheek.
CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana wincing in agony and screaming through clenched teeth.
JULIANA: Ahhh!
CAMERA: Medium shot of the Constable forcefully grappling Alexander by his coat collar, slamming him back against the gate.
ALEXANDER: Juliana!
CAMERA: Ground-level shot of Juliana frantically digging and scraping at the frozen dirt and dried bramble pods with both bloody hands.
ACTION: Juliana digs her torn fingers into the frost-hardened earth, turning over rocks and dead vegetation.
CAMERA: Medium close-up of Alexander struggling against the Constable, his face twisted in grief and rage.
ALEXANDER: Juliana!
CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana lying on her stomach among the thorns, bleeding cuts running down her forehead, cheeks, and bare arms.
JULIANA: Please, ring... you have to be here.
ACTION: Her blood-smeared index finger brushes against a solid metallic object half-buried in the frozen dirt beneath a thorny branch.
CAMERA: Extreme close-up macro shot of an ornate antique gold ring set with a massive, radiant emerald resting in the frosted soil.
cliffhanger: Extreme close-up macro shot of an ornate antique gold ring set with a massive, radiant emerald resting in the frosted soil.

INFORMANT: But they have separated her from the household. She is watched constantly. Every letter she sends is checked. Every visitor is questioned.
CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Alexander's right hand clenching into a powerful, trembling fist at his coat seam, veins bulging with restrained violence.
INFORMANT: There are almost no loyal servants left around her.
CAMERA: Low-angle shot past Alexander toward the informant.
INFORMANT: The people who served your family for years have been dismissed, frightened away, or replaced.
ACTION: Alexander lifts his gaze toward the cold forest canopy, his breathing heavy with profound anguish.
ALEXANDER: My mother is a prisoner in her own house.
CAMERA: Close-up of the informant looking steadily at Alexander.
INFORMANT: And everyone believes you are dead.
CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Alexander's scarred eye and grimly set mouth.
ALEXANDER: Then let them believe it a little longer.
INFORMANT: And when we have the proof?
CAMERA: Dramatic low-angle push-in on Alexander's commanding silhouette, his combat scar etched sharply against the fog.
ALEXANDER: Then Ashburg will remember who it belongs to.
CAMERA: Wide atmospheric shot of the shadowy barn loft. Moonlight filters through vertical wooden slats, illuminating Juliana seated on a pile of straw beside a warm, glowing kerosene lantern.
CAMERA: Over-the-shoulder close-up of Juliana's bandaged hands tracing the detailed botanical drawing on the charred page of her mother's herbal.
CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's face, silent tears streaming down her soot-smudged cheeks as her chin quivers.
ACTION: The heavy wooden barn doors creak open. Alexander steps into the lantern light, carrying a bundle of firewood and a thick blanket under his arm.
JULIANA: We have lost everything.
CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana breaking down in tears over her open book, struggling to breathe through her weeping.
JULIANA: I don't know what we will do tomorrow.

CAMERA: Close-up of the elder villager's rough, weathered hands offering a fresh loaf of artisan bread wrapped in cloth against the smoking timber ruins.
ELDER VILLAGER: You saved mine, too.
CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana, tears spilling down her cheeks as she smiles through her grief.
JULIANA: Thank you.
ACTION: Alexander steps forward and accepts the thick folded blankets and a wooden bucket from the villager.
ALEXANDER: We will not forget this kindness.
ELDER VILLAGER: Neither will the village.
CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana looking back one last time at the devastated doorway of her ruined sanctuary, hugging the ledger tightly.
JULIANA: Goodbye, Blackwood.
ACTION: Juliana turns her back on the ruins. Wide tracking shot from behind as Alexander and Juliana walk side by side down the stone path, leaving the smoldering ash behind as the scene fades into black.
CAMERA: Medium shot tracking Alexander from behind as he stands waiting beside a moss-covered ancient tree trunk in the dense, fog-laden forest.
ACTION: A bald, scarred man dressed in a dark coat emerges from between the trees, immediately coming to a halt and bowing with clasped hands in formal deference.
INFORMANT: Your Grace.
CAMERA: Medium close-up of Alexander turning toward his operative, his eyes dark with calculating authority.
ALEXANDER: Tell me what is happening in Ashburg.
INFORMANT: Lord Sterling's influence has grown since your disappearance. He has men in the county offices, the courts, even among the household staff.
CAMERA: Slow push-in on Alexander's rugged, scarred face, his jaw tightening with simmering rage as he listens.
INFORMANT: Rupert has become the face of Ashburg. He sits in your father's room, signs your estate papers, gives orders as though the title already belongs to him.
CAMERA: Medium shot of the bald informant standing among the towering trees, reporting solemnly.
INFORMANT: And Lady Catherine, she behaves as though she is already the future duchess.
CAMERA: Close-up of the informant, his voice dropping into urgent, discreet concern.
INFORMANT: But they have separated her from the household. She is watched constantly. Every letter she sends is checked. Every visitor is questioned.
CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Alexander's right hand clenching into a powerful, trembling fist at his coat seam, veins bulging with restrained violence.
INFORMANT: There are almost no loyal servants left around her.
CAMERA: Low-angle shot past Alexander toward the informant.
INFORMANT: The people who served your family for years have been dismissed, frightened away, or replaced.
ACTION: Alexander lifts his gaze toward the cold forest canopy, his breathing heavy with profound anguish.
ALEXANDER: My mother is a prisoner in her own house.
CAMERA: Close-up of the informant looking steadily at Alexander.
INFORMANT: And everyone believes you are dead.
cliffhanger: And everyone believes you are dead.

transcript:
ACTION: The heavy wooden barn doors creak open. Alexander steps into the lantern light, carrying a bundle of firewood and a thick blanket under his arm.
JULIANA: We have lost everything.
CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana breaking down in tears over her open book, struggling to breathe through her weeping.
JULIANA: I don't know what we will do tomorrow.
ACTION: Alexander steps up behind her and gently drapes the thick woolen blanket over her trembling shoulders, resting his hands reassuringly on her.
ALEXANDER: Tomorrow, we begin again.
CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana turning her tear-drenched eyes up toward Alexander, her face filled with longing and newfound hope.
JULIANA: You make it sound so simple.
ACTION: Alexander sits down beside her in the straw. Juliana leans gently against his shoulder, letting her weary head rest against his broad chest.
CAMERA: Slow cinematic push-in on the couple nestled together in the warm lantern glow. Alexander wraps his arm firmly around Juliana as she closes her eyes in exhausted relief, while his piercing gaze stares resolutely into the darkness, determined to reclaim everything that was stolen. --- SCRIPT END ---

LADY JULIANA: Tell me what the apothecary said. Did he not give you medicine?
CAMERA: Close-up of Prudence, her face twisted in bitter anguish as she gestures back toward the rain-soaked outdoors.
PRUDENCE: He shut the door in my face because we have no silver!
CAMERA: Wide shot of Lady Juliana and Prudence facing each other inside the wooden barn, dust motes drifting in the pale light.
PRUDENCE: The manor doctor laughed! He said village boys are not worth his time!
CAMERA: Medium profile shot of Lady Juliana looking down at her bandaged hands, holding Prudence's hand with somber heartache.
LADY JULIANA: We have no clinic now.
LADY JULIANA: Our cottage is ashes. I have nothing left but this coltsfoot.
ACTION: Prudence drops desperately to her knees onto the hay-strewn barn floor, clasping her hands in tearful supplication.
CAMERA: High-angle looking down at Prudence kneeling before Lady Juliana, pleading upward.
PRUDENCE: He is only seven! If you do not come, he will die! You are his only hope, Lady Juliana!
ACTION: Lady Juliana immediately reaches down and pulls Prudence firmly back to her feet, then turns to snatch her heavy leather-bound herbal ledger from the wooden workbench.
CAMERA: Medium shot framing the barn entrance as Lady Juliana lifts Prudence up, grabs her book, and leads the way out.
LADY JULIANA: Stand up. Sinking to your knees will not save him. Let me grab my ledger. We go now.
CAMERA: Tracking wide shot following Lady Juliana and Prudence running side by side along a muddy, puddled village road past thatched stone cottages under a gloomy, overcast sky.
ACTION: Lady Juliana clutches the thick book to her chest as she and Prudence sprint swiftly through the village.
CAMERA: Low-angle medium shot of seven-year-old Toby lying on a makeshift straw pallet before a roaring fireplace, coughing weakly.
SOUND: Heavy, raspy chest coughs echoing in the small room, accompanied by crackling hearth fire.
ACTION: Lady Juliana rushes in, sets the ledger on the rustic wooden table, and quickly flips open the pages.
CAMERA: Close-up of Lady Juliana rapidly scanning the botanical illustrations and handwritten remedies in the book.
LADY JULIANA: His skin is burning hot.
ACTION: Lady Juliana places her bandaged hand against Toby's flushed, sweating forehead as he wheezes painfully.
CAMERA: Medium close-up of Lady Juliana tending to Toby, with Prudence standing anxiously in the background.
LADY JULIANA: Prudence, fetch hot water immediately!
CAMERA: Medium shot of Prudence nodding rapidly, rushing toward the stone hearth.
PRUDENCE: Yes! Right away, I will get it!
ACTION: Prudence wraps a cloth around the iron handle of the steaming kettle resting over the hearth fire and lifts it.
CAMERA: Close-up top-down view of Lady Juliana's bandaged fingers gently touching an ink illustration of chamomile flowers in the open ledger.
LADY JULIANA: I cannot let my own weariness stop me. This boy needs my mother's knowledge.
ACTION: Lady Juliana crushes dried herbal leaves into a dark wooden bowl between her bandaged hands, then pours steaming water over them from the kettle.
CAMERA: Close-up of hot water pouring into the bowl, releasing aromatic vapors from the dried herbs.
ACTION: Lady Juliana sits beside the pallet and brings the steaming herbal bowl close to Toby's face while Prudence cradles his shoulders.
CAMERA: Medium shot of Lady Juliana, Prudence, and Toby huddled together by the warm glow of the fire.
LADY JULIANA: Lift his shoulders, Prudence. Hold the steam close. Let him inhale.
CAMERA: Close-up of Prudence supporting Toby's head, whispering tenderly into his ear.
PRUDENCE: Like this? Toby, breathe it in, sweet boy.
hook: Tell me what the apothecary said. Did he not give you medicine?
cliffhanger: Like this? Toby, breathe it in, sweet boy.

CAMERA: Medium close-up of Lady Juliana looking into Prudence's tearful face with compassionate urgency.
LADY JULIANA: Oh dear. Breathe. Tell me what has happened.
CAMERA: Close-up of Prudence weeping, clutching her hands to her chest in agony.
PRUDENCE: My little brother Toby... his chest is burning! He cannot breathe!
CAMERA: Close-up of Lady Juliana, her brow furrowing with concern.
LADY JULIANA: Tell me what the apothecary said. Did he not give you medicine?
CAMERA: Close-up of Prudence, her face twisted in bitter anguish as she gestures back toward the rain-soaked outdoors.
PRUDENCE: He shut the door in my face because we have no silver!
CAMERA: Wide shot of Lady Juliana and Prudence facing each other inside the wooden barn, dust motes drifting in the pale light.
PRUDENCE: The manor doctor laughed! He said village boys are not worth his time!
CAMERA: Medium profile shot of Lady Juliana looking down at her bandaged hands, holding Prudence's hand with somber heartache.
LADY JULIANA: We have no clinic now.
LADY JULIANA: Our cottage is ashes. I have nothing left but this coltsfoot.
ACTION: Prudence drops desperately to her knees onto the hay-strewn barn floor, clasping her hands in tearful supplication.
CAMERA: High-angle looking down at Prudence kneeling before Lady Juliana, pleading upward.
PRUDENCE: He is only seven! If you do not come, he will die! You are his only hope, Lady Juliana!
ACTION: Lady Juliana immediately reaches down and pulls Prudence firmly back to her feet, then turns to snatch her heavy leather-bound herbal ledger from the wooden workbench.
CAMERA: Medium shot framing the barn entrance as Lady Juliana lifts Prudence up, grabs her book, and leads the way out.
LADY JULIANA: Stand up. Sinking to your knees will not save him. Let me grab my ledger. We go now.
CAMERA: Tracking wide shot following Lady Juliana and Prudence running side by side along a muddy, puddled village road past thatched stone cottages under a gloomy, overcast sky.
ACTION: Lady Juliana clutches the thick book to her chest as she and Prudence sprint swiftly through the village.
CAMERA: Low-angle medium shot of seven-year-old Toby lying on a makeshift straw pallet before a roaring fireplace, coughing weakly.
SOUND: Heavy, raspy chest coughs echoing in the small room, accompanied by crackling hearth fire.
ACTION: Lady Juliana rushes in, sets the ledger on the rustic wooden table, and quickly flips open the pages.
CAMERA: Close-up of Lady Juliana rapidly scanning the botanical illustrations and handwritten remedies in the book.
LADY JULIANA: His skin is burning hot.
ACTION: Lady Juliana places her bandaged hand against Toby's flushed, sweating forehead as he wheezes painfully.
CAMERA: Medium close-up of Lady Juliana tending to Toby, with Prudence standing anxiously in the background.
LADY JULIANA: Prudence, fetch hot water immediately!
CAMERA: Medium shot of Prudence nodding rapidly, rushing toward the stone hearth.
PRUDENCE: Yes! Right away, I will get it!
ACTION: Prudence wraps a cloth around the iron handle of the steaming kettle resting over the hearth fire and lifts it.
CAMERA: Close-up top-down view of Lady Juliana's bandaged fingers gently touching an ink illustration of chamomile flowers in the open ledger.
LADY JULIANA: I cannot let my own weariness stop me. This boy needs my mother's knowledge.
ACTION: Lady Juliana crushes dried herbal leaves into a dark wooden bowl between her bandaged hands, then pours steaming water over them from the kettle.
CAMERA: Close-up of hot water pouring into the bowl, releasing aromatic vapors from the dried herbs.
hook: Oh dear. Breathe. Tell me what has happened.
cliffhanger: Close-up of hot water pouring into the bowl, releasing aromatic vapors from the dried herbs.

JULIANA: It contains years of her work! Her knowledge! Everything she left me!
CAMERA: Full shot of Catherine turning gracefully on the dungeon steps, holding the book loosely at her side.
CAMERA: Medium close-up pushing in on Catherine as she presents the worn botanical book with both gloved hands.
CATHERINE: Your mother's little book of weeds?
CATHERINE: You still call this a legacy?
CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana held firmly between the guards, glaring back with fierce defiance.
JULIANA: It is medicine!
CAMERA: Medium close-up of Catherine smiling condescendingly.
CATHERINE: Of course.
CAMERA: Overhead close-up of Catherine's gloved fingers flipping through the herbarium's delicate, hand-drawn floral remedies and annotations.
CATHERINE: Roots. Leaves. Powders. Strange mixtures written in a dead woman's hand.
CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine tucking the book under her arm, her eyes glinting with malicious intent.
CATHERINE: The magistrate will call it witchcraft.
CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana lunging against the guard's grip, her teeth bared in indignation.
JULIANA: You know that is a lie!
CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine lifting her chin arrogantly against the stone backdrop.
CATHERINE: I know exactly what I need him to believe.
CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana thrashing frantically against the two guards.
JULIANA: You cannot just destroy it!
CAMERA: Tight close-up of Catherine's eyes narrowing into an icy, venomous gaze.
CATHERINE: I can burn it.
CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's stricken expression, her eyes widening in horror.
CATHERINE: And when they find your corpse at the end of the rope...
CAMERA: Side close-up of Catherine leaning slightly forward, her voice low and merciless.
CATHERINE: ...no one will remember what was written inside.
CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana screaming back in raw outrage.
JULIANA: You are doing this because I saved the Duchess!
CAMERA: Medium low-angle shot of Catherine standing rigid in her silk gown, contempt etched across her features.
CATHERINE: I am doing this because women like you forget their place.
CAMERA: Quick pan from Juliana's apron up to Catherine's face.
CATHERINE: You were cast out once.
CAMERA: Extreme close-up on Catherine's smiling lips and cold blue eyes.
CATHERINE: You should have stayed forgotten.
hook: It contains years of her work! Her knowledge! Everything she left me!

transcript:
ELDER NOBLEMAN: You have a rat in your cellar, Rupert. And the servants are beginning to smell it.
CAMERA: Close-up of Rupert defensive and agitated.
RUPERT: The Ashcroft girl is locked tight. Nobody knows she is down there.
CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Elder Nobleman fixing Rupert with a piercing, contemptuous glare.
ELDER NOBLEMAN: The kitchen maids are whispering. They see the soup bowls returned unwiped. They see your guards outside the lower grates.
CAMERA: Medium shot of Rupert looking down, nervously pulling at his black leather gloves as dread creeps over his face.
RUPERT: She knows the Duchess was poisoned.
CAMERA: Tight close-up on the Elder Nobleman's unyielding eyes narrowing in cold calculation.
CAMERA: Tight close-up of Rupert swallows hard, breathless with dread.
RUPERT: If she speaks...
CAMERA: Medium two-shot as the Elder Nobleman lunges forward aggressively, stepping into Rupert's personal space.
ACTION: The Elder Nobleman thrusts the gold knob of his walking stick directly against Rupert's chest, pinning him against the wall.
ELDER NOBLEMAN: Then make certain she isn't! A peasant weed, Rupert! You do not store weeds in your cellar, you burn them!
CAMERA: Low-angle close-up of Rupert gasping softly, intimidated by the cane pressed firmly beneath his cravat.
RUPERT: What are you suggesting?
CAMERA: Medium shot as the Elder Nobleman withdraws his cane and turns sharply toward the library doors.
ELDER NOBLEMAN: We stop hiding the prisoner.
CAMERA: Tracking shot from behind the Elder Nobleman as he pushes open the heavy double doors into the dark wood-paneled library.
SOUND: The heavy creak of massive mahogany doors gliding open on brass hinges.
CAMERA: Front medium shot of the Elder Nobleman pausing inside the library doorway, Rupert following behind him.
ELDER NOBLEMAN: We give them a reason to condemn her.

CAMERA: Close-up of Rupert defensive and agitated.
RUPERT: The Ashcroft girl is locked tight. Nobody knows she is down there.
CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Elder Nobleman fixing Rupert with a piercing, contemptuous glare.
ELDER NOBLEMAN: The kitchen maids are whispering. They see the soup bowls returned unwiped. They see your guards outside the lower grates.
CAMERA: Medium shot of Rupert looking down, nervously pulling at his black leather gloves as dread creeps over his face.
RUPERT: She knows the Duchess was poisoned.
CAMERA: Tight close-up on the Elder Nobleman's unyielding eyes narrowing in cold calculation.
CAMERA: Tight close-up of Rupert swallows hard, breathless with dread.
RUPERT: If she speaks...
CAMERA: Medium two-shot as the Elder Nobleman lunges forward aggressively, stepping into Rupert's personal space.
ACTION: The Elder Nobleman thrusts the gold knob of his walking stick directly against Rupert's chest, pinning him against the wall.
ELDER NOBLEMAN: Then make certain she isn't! A peasant weed, Rupert! You do not store weeds in your cellar, you burn them!
CAMERA: Low-angle close-up of Rupert gasping softly, intimidated by the cane pressed firmly beneath his cravat.
RUPERT: What are you suggesting?
CAMERA: Medium shot as the Elder Nobleman withdraws his cane and turns sharply toward the library doors.
ELDER NOBLEMAN: We stop hiding the prisoner.
CAMERA: Tracking shot from behind the Elder Nobleman as he pushes open the heavy double doors into the dark wood-paneled library.
SOUND: The heavy creak of massive mahogany doors gliding open on brass hinges.
CAMERA: Front medium shot of the Elder Nobleman pausing inside the library doorway, Rupert following behind him.
ELDER NOBLEMAN: We give them a reason to condemn her.
CAMERA: Wide shot of Catherine standing regally before the roaring stone hearth, dressed in an ornate burgundy and gold brocade gown, slowly unfurling a red lace fan.
CATHERINE: You have a solution?
CAMERA: Side profile close-up of the Elder Nobleman speaking with icy confidence.
ELDER NOBLEMAN: We use the law to destroy her.
RUPERT: The law?

ALEXANDER'S MOTHER: And you?

ALEXANDER: While the world mourned a dead heir.
CAMERA: Close-up on his mother's sorrowful gaze lifting toward him.
ALEXANDER'S MOTHER: And I mourned you.
CAMERA: Medium shot of Alexander looking down, his harsh features softening momentarily with sorrow.
ALEXANDER: I know.
CAMERA: Medium close-up on his mother bowing her head toward the rustic tabletop, weeping in utter despair.
ALEXANDER'S MOTHER: I trusted them.
CAMERA: Wide shot as Alexander stands tall beside the weeping mother seated at the table.
ALEXANDER: You trusted family.
CAMERA: Profile close-up of Alexander stepping closer to the door, staring out into the falling snow.
ALEXANDER: They used that trust against you.
CAMERA: Alexander steps back toward the table, leaning in urgently toward his mother.
ALEXANDER: Mother... Juliana...
CAMERA: Medium close-up on Alexander leaning both hands on the table, desperate for answers.
ALEXANDER: She went into Ashbourne Manor to save you. She never came back.
CAMERA: Tight close-up on Alexander's strained, furrowed brow.
ALEXANDER: I thought perhaps she stayed with you.
CAMERA: Close-up of his mother looking up at him, agony and hesitation washing over her face.
ALEXANDER'S MOTHER: Alexander...
CAMERA: Quick push-in close-up on Alexander, his eyes snapping open in sudden panic.
ALEXANDER: What?
CAMERA: Close-up on his mother, tears shining in the amber lamplight.
ALEXANDER'S MOTHER: She did come to me.
CAMERA: Medium two-shot as Alexander bends over the table, crowding his mother with fierce desperation.
ALEXANDER: Is she still at Ashbourne?
CAMERA: Close-up on Alexander's mother shutting her eyes and weeping, shaking her head in deep anguish.
ALEXANDER'S MOTHER: No...
CAMERA: Medium shot as Alexander towers over her, his breathing turning ragged.
ALEXANDER: Then where is she?
CAMERA: Tight close-up on Alexander's mother crying out in wretched guilt and horror.
ALEXANDER'S MOTHER: They arrested her!
CAMERA: Close-up on Alexander, his expression freezing in complete shock.
ALEXANDER: Arrested?

HIGH PRIEST: And no clerk in London ever entered your name in the Royal register, because as far as the Crown knew, Alexander Ashburton was already dead.
CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana lifting her chin, tearful yet burning with righteous fury.
JULIANA: I didn't ask this church for permission to survive, Father.
CAMERA: Medium two-shot of Juliana standing proudly beside Alexander.
JULIANA: I won't ask it for permission to love.
CAMERA: Close-up of the High Priest looking down, a sinister, condescending smirk gracing his lips.
HIGH PRIEST: Love doesn't make a Duchess, girl. Paper does.
CAMERA: Slow push-in medium close-up on Juliana, her voice trembling with intense indignation.
JULIANA: Then look at this floor honestly, for once.
JULIANA: A church called me unworthy.
CAMERA: Quick cut to the High Priest maintaining a smug, impenetrable stare.
JULIANA: A church chained me.
CAMERA: Extreme close-up on Juliana's face as she shouts at the priest.
JULIANA: Now a church calls my marriage a lie!
JULIANA: God married us, Father! You are just angry no one asked you first!
CAMERA: Medium close-up of Catherine leaning against a stone archway, whispering with venomous mockery.
CATHERINE: Careful, healer. The floor isn't finished with you.
CAMERA: Close-up of the High Priest pressing the document against his chest, his eyes darkening with anger.
HIGH PRIEST: Careful, girl. You mistake my patience for weakness.
CAMERA: Low-angle shot of the High Priest stepping up the altar steps toward them.
HIGH PRIEST: God did not marry you. A frightened parishioner did, without leave, without license, without the Crown's blessing!
CAMERA: Brief insert of Catherine smirking as she watches from the side.
CAMERA: Wide shot of the High Priest waving the letter overhead before the congregation.
HIGH PRIEST: And I have the power to undo in one hearing what took you three years to steal!
CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine listening eagerly.
CAMERA: Profile medium shot of Alexander confronting the High Priest face-to-face at the foot of the altar.
ALEXANDER: A Duke's marriage is judged by the Crown's peerage court, not by a parish priest's seal.

cliffhanger: A Duke's marriage is judged by the Crown's peerage court, not by a parish priest's seal.

JULIANA: I didn't ask this church for permission to survive, Father.
CAMERA: Medium two-shot of Juliana standing proudly beside Alexander.
JULIANA: I won't ask it for permission to love.
CAMERA: Close-up of the High Priest looking down, a sinister, condescending smirk gracing his lips.
HIGH PRIEST: Love doesn't make a Duchess, girl. Paper does.
CAMERA: Slow push-in medium close-up on Juliana, her voice trembling with intense indignation.
JULIANA: Then look at this floor honestly, for once.
JULIANA: A church called me unworthy.
CAMERA: Quick cut to the High Priest maintaining a smug, impenetrable stare.
JULIANA: A church chained me.
CAMERA: Extreme close-up on Juliana's face as she shouts at the priest.
JULIANA: Now a church calls my marriage a lie!
JULIANA: God married us, Father! You are just angry no one asked you first!
CAMERA: Medium close-up of Catherine leaning against a stone archway, whispering with venomous mockery.
CATHERINE: Careful, healer. The floor isn't finished with you.
CAMERA: Close-up of the High Priest pressing the document against his chest, his eyes darkening with anger.
HIGH PRIEST: Careful, girl. You mistake my patience for weakness.
CAMERA: Low-angle shot of the High Priest stepping up the altar steps toward them.
HIGH PRIEST: God did not marry you. A frightened parishioner did, without leave, without license, without the Crown's blessing!
CAMERA: Brief insert of Catherine smirking as she watches from the side.
CAMERA: Wide shot of the High Priest waving the letter overhead before the congregation.
HIGH PRIEST: And I have the power to undo in one hearing what took you three years to steal!
hook: I didn't ask this church for permission to survive, Father.
cliffhanger: And I have the power to undo in one hearing what took you three years to steal!

ACTION: Father Thomas clasps his hands behind his back, turning slightly away to ponder the gravity of her words.
CATHERINE: Is that so unreasonable coming from a woman the church itself just humiliated back into relevance?
CAMERA: Medium shot on Father Thomas turning back around to face her, his countenance etched with genuine concern.
